title: FM4 Navigation Safety (NS 1) practice exam 1
notes: Practice format, not the official exam. Question count and pass mark are not stated in TP 2293 (2016) for this exam; 70 per cent is our own placeholder and must be confirmed with Transport Canada. The time limit is scaled from the stated exam duration and is our own assumption. The mock-exam schema only names modules, so the blueprint is a single module entry. The exact question ids planned for each exam are in docs/fm4-mock-draw.json, split so that exams of the same subject share no question. Until the app can pin question ids, a random draw from the module bank will not guarantee that split. Questions are original practice items, not Transport Canada questions. Study aid, not a navigation aid.
